steps: Referrer contacts ACU to receive a unique referral code and shares it. Friend joins ACU, selects 'Friend or family member' and enters the code online, makes $25 savings deposit and $25 checking deposit within 60 days.
catches: New member relationship with America's Credit Union, age 18 or older. No previous relationship within the last 6 months and no previous losses to the credit union. Credit union membership and checking account qualifications apply, including an initial savings deposit of $25; a $25 deposit to the checking account must be made within the first 60 days of account opening. Referrer must have an account in good standing. Online applicants select 'Friend or family member' and enter the referral code. Federally insured by NCUA. Terms, including termination, may change without notice.
